p3.title: Emissions & Onboarding Preparation
p3.subtitle: Convert your Scope 1/2 data into a J-Credit onboarding foundation
p3.positioningNote: ShellCarbon does not replace your existing carbon inventory or ISO advisors. This page converts your Scope 1/2 inventory data into a foundation for J-Credit purchasing, holding, transfer, declaration and ESG document management.
p3.disclaimer: Recommendations are for reference only. Actual purchases, declarations, retirements and disclosures must be confirmed by the enterprise per advisor, legal, accounting and regulatory requirements.

p6.title: ShellCarbon Main Engine
p6.subtitle: Hardware carbon capture data and future international market linkage
p6.completenessNote: Covers: hardware sensor data, on-site inspection documents, third-party verification data
p6.roadmapDesc: J-Credit is ShellCarbon's first market entry point. The same Main Engine will progressively expand to Puro.earth and Verra, building a long-term carbon asset infrastructure for holding enterprises.
p6.phase2Desc: Align with high-value carbon removal markets
p6.marketLinkDesc: J-Credit is ShellCarbon's first market entry. The hardware carbon capture data and marine mineral material usage accumulated by the Main Engine can serve as a verification basis for future linkage with Puro.earth, Verra and other international carbon markets.
